# anthropic_compliance_settings (Resource)

Manages the organization's Compliance Settings (`/v1/organizations/compliance_settings`), which turn the Compliance API on or off. Declare it at most once per organization. Destroy only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the setting as it is. Import with the fixed ID `compliance_settings`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Singleton per organization. Destroying it leaves the organization's setting unchanged.
resource "anthropic_compliance_settings" "this" {
  state = "enabled"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `state` (String) Whether the Compliance API is enabled: `enabled` or `disabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `compliance_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The compliance settings singleton always imports with this fixed ID.
terraform import anthropic_compliance_settings.this compliance_settings
```
